title: SpotsReach
description:
Whether characters can reach places where they do something, with the
paths as they are or with objects hidden (ADR 0069).

place.description: The worldspace or interior cell asked about.

spots.description: Each spot asked about, in the order asked.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.

SpotReach.description: Whether characters can reach one spot.

ground.description:
The nearest point on paths characters can reach, within about 30
metres, in whole game units: where the spot could be moved to.

metresOff.description:
How far the spot stands from the nearest path characters can
reach, in whole metres; `None` if none is near.

SpotState.description: Whether characters can reach a spot.

oneOf.description: A path characters reach leads to it.

It stands on paths, but no way leads there from the rest of the
world.
No path is near enough to use it from.
The paths there could not be read.
